description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate plaintext application credentials and secrets to Azure Key Vault-backed configuration.
tasks.reason: The current configuration includes hardcoded credentials that increase security risk and operational overhead.
tasks.requirements: Replace hardcoded credentials used by the application with Azure Key Vault-backed secret retrieval and configuration. Preserve existing business behavior. Addresses issues: CWE-259: Use of Hard-coded Password, CWE-798: Use of Hard-coded Credentials.

tasks.description: Modernize database authentication from username/password to Azure Managed Identity.
tasks.reason: Managed identity removes credential rotation burden and aligns database access with Azure security best practices.
tasks.requirements: Migrate database connection authentication to Azure Managed Identity for Azure SQL while maintaining current data access behavior. Remove reliance on static DB credentials in runtime configuration. Addresses issues: CWE-259: Use of Hard-coded Password, CWE-798: Use of Hard-coded Credentials.

tasks.description: Scan and remediate known dependency CVEs before Azure deployment.
tasks.reason: Mandatory dependency vulnerabilities must be remediated to reduce security and availability risk before release.
tasks.requirements: Scan dependencies and remediate CVEs with minimum safe versions, documenting major-version risks when applicable. Verify build and tests after remediation. Addresses issues: CVE-2023-5072: Java: DoS Vulnerability in JSON-JAVA, CVE-2022-45688: json stack overflow vulnerability.

tasks.description: Containerize and deploy the modernized application to Azure Container Apps.
tasks.reason: Azure deployment is required to complete migration and run the application in a managed cloud environment.
tasks.requirements: Deploy the application to Azure Container Apps using an Azure-native deployment workflow. Ensure deployment configuration uses managed identity where applicable and preserves existing API behavior.
